summary: This video breaks down the kit and official ratings for the Legendary Necrosis Support hero Sia, who is available in a targeted summon banner until October 28. Sia receives an official S rating for PvE and Support, and an A rating for PvP. Her passive Cangue of Memory increases team damage by 10%, reduces damage taken by 10%, and converts prevented damage into Mercy to heal and shield the team. Her battle skill Painbound inflicts Attack Penalty II and Recharge Penalty on all enemies, while her ultimate Mask of Grief cleanses, heals, shields, grants 10 seconds of Parry, and inflicts Repentance on all enemies.
